mechanism: Galantamine increases acetylcholine levels via cholinesterase inhibition, and when combined with phenelzine (MAOI), there is additive risk of cholinergic toxicity and potential serotonergic interaction through indirect sympathomimetic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only with extreme caution and close monitoring; if necessary, ensure adequate washout period (14 days) after MAOI discontinuation before initiating galantamine.
